reviews.comment: Had him for MATH 151 Honors. Took AP Calc BC in high school, but had to study for the A. Decent lectures, nice guy. Wyatt was a great TA.

Nguyen is great! The proofs suck, but after watching my class struggle through them on the first exam, he removed them from the final. Wyatt is the best TA I've ever had, so together it's an awesome combo

The class was difficult as it was an honors course. The proofs made me, who did Calculus BC in high school, have to study more than I thought I would have to. The tests are mostly free response, and he grades very leniently, so they were fairly easy. If you get Wyatt Smith as a TA, he is excellent too.

Dr. Nguyen is a fantastic math professor. His lectures hit the right balance of theory and examples, and he hand selects homework problems so that they line up with lecture examples. He keeps all his notes online and makes a review before each exam that hits all the content.

Dr. Nguyen is a really great professor, his notes are the best I have seen so far in college and he is very helpful outside of class. The only downside is that he is a slightly harsh grader and assigns a lot of homework.
Good lecturer; prepared us well for exams and good at explaining concepts and balancing with concepts and applications

Very well-rounded. Great lectures, organized class, abundance of extra credit opportunities, and considerate when things (inevitably) come up. One downside is that he tests for mastery, so don't expect an easy A. If you master the topics, an A is achievable, but it's hardly a freebie. Also posted pictures of the textbook so we didn't have to buy it

Dr. Nguyen is a great professor. His lectures are easy to follow and concise. Tests are taken from the exam review packets he makes or from the textbook homework, so there won't be any curveballs thrown at you. He also gives a moderate amount of extra credit. However, he's not going to hold student's hands, so some heavy effort is required to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very lecture heavy course, but that's linear for you. Nguyen made the content of the course clear and concise, which made things very manageable, so long as you stay on top of the work assigned. Exams were difficult, but fair, and review problems almost word for word for the exams are released ahead of time for you to study. Nguyen was a great prof

About as by the book a professor gets. Lectures are very succinct and to the point, and has lecture notes on canvas. Homework was on the long side, but exams were very fair while still covering every inch of the content. Very forgiving with partial credit. Had an extra credit project at the end.
